# ONNX schema provenance

`onnx.proto` is the official schema generated by the ONNX project and is
vendored solely to generate the optional inference importer's Protobuf C++
binding. Generated `.pb.h` and `.pb.cc` files are build artifacts and are not
part of Joggle's source or public API.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/onnx/onnx>
- Release: `v1.19.0`
- Source: `onnx/onnx.proto`
- Upstream byte SHA-256: `1fcbd4d5879b352d891a04656a76755114f1ff0a10de77cf2c53a65310132a13`
- Vendored SHA-256: `58f844f7b19b30bc38c68a081faef1f131d6858fd2166b061c6bbb98f75f5d0e`
- License: Apache-2.0 (the vendored file carries its SPDX identifier)

The vendored copy differs only by removal of the upstream final blank line.
The core `joggle` library does not include or link Protobuf. This schema is
compiled only when `JOGGLE_BUILD_ONNX=ON`.
